import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import envelope
import base64, hashlib, hmac
def b64(text):
    try:
        return base64.standard_b64decode(text)
    except Exception:
        return None
env = envelope.sign('t', b'{"a":1}', b'k')
assert set(env) == {'payloadType', 'payload', 'signatures'} and env['payloadType'] == 't', 'envelope_fields: an envelope has exactly payloadType, payload and signatures; got %r' % env
assert b64(env['payload']) == b'{"a":1}', 'envelope_fields: payload is the standard base64 of the payload bytes; got %r' % env['payload']
sigs = env['signatures']
assert isinstance(sigs, list) and len(sigs) == 1 and set(sigs[0]) == {'keyid', 'sig'}, 'envelope_fields: signatures is a list of one object with exactly keyid and sig; got %r' % sigs
assert sigs[0]['keyid'] == b'k'.hex(), 'envelope_fields: keyid is the key, hex-encoded; got %r' % sigs[0]['keyid']
want = hmac.new(b'k', envelope.pae('t', b'{"a":1}'), hashlib.sha256).digest()
assert b64(sigs[0]['sig']) == want, 'envelope_fields: sig is the standard base64 of the HMAC-SHA256 of the pre-authentication encoding under the key; got %r' % sigs[0]['sig']

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import payload
import json, os
os.environ['DEMO_SEED'] = 'secret-seed-value-7f3a'
got = payload.identity('DEMO_SEED')
expected = {'protocol': 'sdk.syberlabs.space/certificate/v0alpha1', 'payload_type': 'application/vnd.syberlabs.admission-certificate+json', 'version': 0, 'issuer': {'tool': 'syberlabs.certificate/0', 'host': 'syberlabs.host', 'seed_env': 'DEMO_SEED', 'signing': 'in-process'}}
assert 'secret-seed-value-7f3a' not in json.dumps(got), 'identity: the seed value must never appear in the payload; the issuer records the name of the variable under seed_env'
assert got == expected, 'identity: the identity block is protocol, payload_type, version 0 (an integer) and issuer {tool syberlabs.certificate/0, host syberlabs.host, seed_env <the variable name>, signing in-process}; expected %r, got %r' % (expected, got)
layer_order:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import layers
called = []
def ok(name):
    def layer():
        called.append(name)
    return layer
def fail(name, code):
    def layer():
        called.append(name)
        return code
    return layer
r = layers.run_layers(ok('s'), ok('r'), ok('j'))
assert (r['passed'], r['reason'], r['states'], called) == (True, None, ('ok', 'ok', 'ok'), ['s', 'r', 'j']), 'layer_order: the layers run in the order signature, repository, journal and each ok layer records the state ok; got %r after calls %r' % (r, called)
called.clear(); r = layers.run_layers(ok('s'), fail('r', 'tree_mismatch'), fail('j', 'chain_head_mismatch'))
assert (r['passed'], r['reason'], r['states'], called) == (False, 'tree_mismatch', ('ok', 'tree_mismatch', None), ['s', 'r']), 'layer_order: the first failing layer stops the run: its code is the reason and the state of its layer, and the layers after it do not run and record None; got %r after calls %r' % (r, called)
called.clear(); r = layers.run_layers(ok('s'), None, ok('j'))
assert (r['passed'], r['reason'], r['states'], called) == (True, None, ('ok', None, 'ok'), ['s', 'j']), 'layer_order: a layer given as None is skipped and recorded None, and the layers after it still run; got %r after calls %r' % (r, called)
called.clear(); r = layers.run_layers(fail('s', 'signature_invalid'), ok('r'), ok('j'))
assert (r['passed'], r['reason'], r['states'], called) == (False, 'signature_invalid', ('signature_invalid', None, None), ['s']), 'layer_order: a failing signature layer ends the run before the repository and journal layers; got %r after calls %r' % (r, called)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import envelope
got = envelope.pae('application/vnd.in-toto+json', b'{}')
expected = b'DSSEv1 28 application/vnd.in-toto+json 2 {}'
assert got == expected, 'pae: the DSSE pre-authentication encoding is DSSEv1, a space, the type length in ASCII decimal, a space, the type, a space, the payload length in ASCII decimal, a space, the payload; expected %r, got %r' % (expected, got)
assert envelope.pae('t', b'') == b'DSSEv1 1 t 0 ', 'pae: an empty payload encodes as DSSEv1 1 t 0 followed by a space; got %r' % envelope.pae('t', b'')

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import statement
payload = {'thread': '8525ff4c-0cf2-4bb0-a556-e2f7029342e1', 'result': {'candidate': 'c1', 'commit': '8dae2e4a00d0d3617d569f6084623616ca2ae3ee', 'tree': '62933f98490b7a2e1c4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c'}, 'admission': {'target_ref': 'refs/heads/syberlabs/8525ff4c'}}
st = statement.wrap(payload)
assert st.get('_type') == 'https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1', 'statement_shape: _type must be https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1 (an in-toto Statement v1); got %r' % st.get('_type')
assert set(st) == {'_type', 'subject', 'predicateType', 'predicate'}, 'statement_shape: a statement has exactly the four fields _type, subject, predicateType and predicate; got %r' % sorted(st)
assert st['predicateType'] == 'https://sdk.syberlabs.space/certificate/v0alpha1', 'statement_shape: predicateType must be https://sdk.syberlabs.space/certificate/v0alpha1; got %r' % st['predicateType']
assert st['predicate'] is payload, 'statement_shape: the predicate is the payload object itself, unchanged, so its canonical bytes inside the statement are the bytes the bare form signs; got %r' % (st['predicate'],)

payload = {'thread': '8525ff4c-0cf2-4bb0-a556-e2f7029342e1', 'result': {'candidate': 'c1', 'commit': '8dae2e4a00d0d3617d569f6084623616ca2ae3ee', 'tree': '62933f98490b7a2e1c4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c'}, 'admission': {'target_ref': 'refs/heads/syberlabs/8525ff4c'}}

assert got == expected, 'subject: exactly one subject, named by the certified target ref (admission.target_ref), whose digest carries the result commit as gitCommit and the result tree as gitTree; expected %r, got %r' % (expected, got)
